raw_segments.text: Meanwhile, I spent my time in drink and riot, till the Lieutenant Colonel put me under arrest
Just at that time, Father sent me six thousand rubles in return for my sending him a deed
giving up all claims upon him, settling our accounts, so to speak, and saying that I wouldn't
I didn't understand a word of it at the time.
Until I came here, Alyosha, till the last few days, indeed, perhaps even now, I haven't
been able to make head or tail of my money affairs with Father.
But never mind that, we'll talk of it later.
